description: This Java source file defines the CandidateView class, a custom Android View responsible for displaying and managing suggestion candidates in the AnySoftKeyboard input method. It handles rendering suggestions, user interactions like touch and gestures, theming, and communication with the input service.

classes.name: CandidateView
classes.description: A custom Android View that displays suggestion candidates for an input method, handling rendering, touch interactions, theming, and communication with the input service.

classes.name: CandidateStripGestureListener
classes.description: Inner class extending GestureDetector.SimpleOnGestureListener to handle gesture events such as scrolling within the CandidateView.

methods.name: CandidateView
methods.description: Constructor initializing the CandidateView with context, attributes, and style.

methods.name: setThemeOverlay
methods.description: Applies a theme overlay to customize the appearance of the candidate suggestions.

methods.name: setKeyboardTheme
methods.description: Configures the visual theme of the candidate view based on the provided KeyboardTheme.

methods.name: onAttachedToWindow
methods.description: Lifecycle method to set up preferences and reactive subscriptions when the view is attached.

methods.name: onDetachedFromWindow
methods.description: Lifecycle method to dispose of reactive subscriptions when the view is detached.

methods.name: setService
methods.description: Sets the input suggestion service interface for communication.

methods.name: computeHorizontalScrollRange
methods.description: Returns the total width of the suggestions for scrolling purposes.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Handles rendering of suggestion words, dividers, and selection highlights.

methods.name: scrollToTarget
methods.description: Animates scrolling to the target scroll position.

methods.name: setSuggestions
methods.description: Populates the view with a list of suggestions and highlights a specific index.

methods.name: showAddToDictionaryHint
methods.description: Displays a suggestion with an option to add the word to the user dictionary.

methods.name: dismissAddToDictionaryHint
methods.description: Removes the add-to-dictionary suggestion if visible.

methods.name: getSuggestions
methods.description: Returns the current list of suggestions.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all suggestions and resets internal state.

methods.name: notifyAboutWordAdded
methods.description: Displays a notification that a word was added to the dictionary.

methods.name: notifyAboutRemovedWord
methods.description: Displays a notification that a word was removed from the dictionary.

methods.name: replaceTypedWord
methods.description: Replaces the first suggestion with a new typed word.

methods.name: getCloseIcon
methods.description: Returns the drawable used as the close icon.
